note: measurement only; no other lane's spike is modified

controls.name: detector_two_sided
controls.must_fire_because: S91's form is caught AND a derived verdict is not; a detector that only ever says yes measures nothing
controls.can_fail_because: the name-resolution branch misses `c3_ok = True`, or the rule widens and flags `len(R) == 5`
controls.null_must_contain: the DERIVED arm -- a rule that flagged every `.observe(` would pass the catching arm alone
controls.detail: synthetic: S91 form -> 1 hit; derived comparison -> 0 hits

controls.name: name_resolution_is_load_bearing
controls.must_fire_because: v1 flagged only a literal FIRST ARGUMENT and could not see the instance that motivated the row
controls.can_fail_because: S91 is reachable without resolving the binding, so removing the branch changes nothing
controls.null_must_contain: a mutant that still finds S91, which would mean the branch is decoration
controls.detail: S91 hits with branch / without; total live with / without

controls.name: fixture_split_two_sided
controls.must_fire_because: a control built dead ON PURPOSE inside demo() is not a defect, and a real one in main() must not be excused as a fixture
controls.can_fail_because: the enclosing-function chain is not recorded, so both cases classify the same way
controls.null_must_contain: a rule that calls everything a fixture, which would pass the demo arm alone

controls.name: reporter_is_not_the_reported
controls.must_fire_because: a spike about dead controls that ships one is the failure it describes, and saying "mine are derived" is not checking it
controls.can_fail_because: any `.observe(` in this spike takes a literal or a constant-bound name as its verdict
controls.null_must_contain: a run in which this file DOES contain a literal verdict, which is what the sweep would print
controls.detail: this spike, scanned by the module it ships

falsifiers.name: f1_existing_guard_already_catches
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a guard that does catch it, which is the state that would kill this row
falsifiers.refutes: if Control.observe's `constant` flag already catches S91's C3, the premise is false and this row closes WRONG
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: f2_s91_is_the_only_site
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the tree-wide sweep finds exactly one live hit
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a tree with one site, which is the state that would close this as a spike bug
falsifiers.detail: live literal verdicts; of which the copied pins template
falsifiers.refutes: if S91 is the only site this is an S91 defect and not a class, and no checker should ship
falsifiers.fires_when: the tree-wide sweep finds exactly one live hit
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: f3_detector_flags_derived
falsifiers.can_fail_because: a verdict computed from a comparison is reported
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a derived verdict being flagged, which is the observation that would stop the ship
falsifiers.refutes: if the detector flags a DERIVED verdict it is not shippable and the false-positive rate is the result, not the count
falsifiers.fires_when: a verdict computed from a comparison is reported
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire
